exposure: Raised renal parameters in women with preeclampsia
cohort: The study included 100 preeclamptic women, with 50 cases having raised renal parameters and 50 controls having normal renal parameters, matched for age group, gestational age, gravida, and pre-eclampsia.
finding: Raised renal parameters among pre-eclamptic women were significantly associated with increased odds of preterm delivery (OR 3.7) and delivery via caesarean section (OR 2.4), and two-fold increased odds of low birth weight.
mod_finding: Raised renal parameters in pre-eclamptic women were associated with 2.4 times increased odds of delivery via caesarean section.
